mismatchTracker.title: Mismatch Tracker
mismatchTracker.subtitle: Track, dispute and resolve payment differences with your providers
mismatchTracker.howItWorks1: Weekly report — A consolidated report per provider with all discrepancies (new + pending)
mismatchTracker.howItWorks2: Three sections — New discrepancies, still pending from previous reports, and recently resolved
mismatchTracker.howItWorks3: Urgent override — For large amounts or missing payments, switch to 'Urgent' and send immediately
mismatchTracker.howItWorks4: Auto-check — After each bank upload, the system looks for automatic resolutions
mismatchTracker.howItWorks5: Tracks times reported — The provider cannot claim they never received it

communications.title: Dispute Communications

communications.noCommunicationsDesc: Emails sent from the Mismatch Tracker will appear here automatically

setup.title: Setup
setup.subtitle: Manage your client portfolio, stores, providers, bank accounts and data privacy
setup.addFirstClient: Add your first client to build your portfolio
setup.disputeEmailDesc: Configure the dispute contact email for each provider. These emails are used when you click 'Send Email' from the Mismatch Tracker
setup.dataResidencyDesc: All data stored exclusively in European data centres (Frankfurt / Paris)
setup.encryptionDesc: Encrypted at rest. TLS 1.3 in transit. Your bank statements are unreadable to us without your session
setup.zeroSharingDesc: We do not share your data with tax authorities, advertisers, AI trainers or third parties. Never
setup.gdprDesc: Right of access, right to erasure, right to portability. Request your data at any time
setup.autoPurgeDesc: Automatically delete transaction data older than the selected period
setup.dangerZoneDesc: Deleting your data is irreversible. Your bank statements, provider transactions and store configuration will be permanently removed
setup.cloudDbDesc: Connect your own PostgreSQL database. Enterprise plan required. Your data never leaves your infrastructure.
setup.cloudBenefit1: Your data never leaves your infrastructure
setup.cloudBenefit2: Full control over backups and retention
setup.cloudBenefit3: Comply with internal IT security policies
setup.cloudBenefit4: No shared database with other customers
setup.cloudTestMsg: Connection test: In a real deployment this would verify connectivity with your database.
setup.providerConnectDesc: Connect payment providers for automatic transaction syncing. CSV upload is always available as a fallback.
setup.noStoreSelected: No store selected. Please select a store first.
setup.comingSoon: Coming soon — upload CSV for now
setup.legalNotice: Legal Notice: ClearFlow S.L. acts solely as a data processor under GDPR Article 28. You (the data controller) retain full ownership of your business data. If you require a Data Processing Agreement (DPA), contact us at dpa@clearflow.app.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.subtitle: Understand where your money comes from and how fast it arrives.
statistics.emptyDesc: Upload your bank statements and provider reports to see your provider health scorecard, card type breakdown, and monthly trends.

profitability.title: Profitability
profitability.subtitle: See if your store is actually making money. Revenue minus provider fees minus costs equals true profit.
profitability.emptyDesc: Complete your store setup and upload transaction data to see profitability analysis.
profitability.noCosts: No costs added yet. Click "+ Add Cost" to start tracking your expenses.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Generate and download professional reports for your accountant, bank or payment providers.
reports.usageDesc: These reports are generated from your uploaded data and are intended for internal analysis, accountant review, or formal disputes with payment providers. All amounts are shown in EUR. For multi-currency reports, ensure your bank accounts are configured in Setup.
reports.dashboardSummaryDesc: Key metrics, totals, and period-over-period changes across all stores.
reports.profitabilityDesc: Revenue, provider fees, operating costs, and net margin per store.
reports.mismatchDesc: All unmatched transactions, missing payouts, and fee discrepancies with status tracking.
reports.feesDesc: Breakdown of fees per provider, card type, transaction count, and payout timing.
reports.reconciliationDesc: Line-by-line matching between bank statements and provider reports per store and bank account.
reports.healthDesc: Weighted fee analysis, payout speed risk, and health indicators per provider for negotiation insights.
